verdict.rationale: Local discovery and direct, server-free connections are a fair question for a remote desktop tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents AnyDesk finding hosts on the LAN or connecting without an account or vendor relay. The CLI session-start and REST API evidence covers automation and account management, not serverless local connectivity.

support.subject: As a power user, my devices find the host on the local network and connect without an account or a vendor server in between
